crafts.name: Bangle Jar
instructions: Trace a bangle on a piece of cardboard and cut out, repeat for one more piece
Hot glue the bangles together as a stack, the height of the stack depends on how tall you want the jar to be
Hot glue one cardboard circle to the bottom of the stack, this will be the floor of the jar
Paint the other cut out to use as the lid(the lid is optional)
crafts.sustainability_note: The bangles make for a sturdy and durable material, making the jar perfect for long term use.
environmental_benefits: Prevents harmful chemicals from leaking into the enviornment
